bicycle-wheel.b: Bicycle Wheel is a 1913 sculpture by Marcel Duchamp, made of a bicycle wheel mounted upside down on a wooden stool. The original is lost.
a: What Was the AI Psychosis Summit?

in-search-of-paul-klee.b: In Search of Paul Klee (À la recherche de Paul Klee) is a 1970 series of computer drawings by Vera Molnár made in homage to Paul Klee. It is among the plotter works shown in Degrees of Disruption at the V&A in 2026.
a: Degrees of Disruption: Vera Molnár at the V&A

cave.b: The CAVE is a room-sized virtual reality system that surrounds the viewer with projected stereo images. Carolina Cruz-Neira, Dan Sandin and Tom DeFanti developed it at the Electronic Visualization Laboratory and first showed it at SIGGRAPH in 1992.
a: Tom DeFanti and Dan Sandin on Playing Images

berl-berl.b: Berl-Berl is a 2021 live simulation with sound by Jakob Kudsk Steensen that engages with vanishing wetlands and rivers in Europe, with composition and music by Matt McCorkle.
a: Jakob Kudsk Steensen on Non-Human Pathways

breather.b: breather is a 2024 series of digital generative art by Kacey Weiniger (Kcdilla) that explicitly encourages the exploration of inner attention.

fazes.b: Fazes is a 1983 work of generative photography by Alyce Kaprow, a member of MIT's Architecture Machine Group, shown in the SIGGRAPH 1983 Art Show.

focos-de-luz-lightbulbs.b: Focos de luz (Lightbulbs) is a 1969 work by Miguel Ángel Vidal.
a: Concrete to Generative: “Real Space” Explorations in South America

namahage-in-tokyo.b: Namahage in Tokyo is a 2017 installation by Etsuko Ichihara.
a: Marlene Wenger on Bringing Magic Back

no-matter.b: NO-MATTER is a 2024 video by Joan Heemskerk made using image recognition.

realm-of-silk.b: Realm Of Silk is a 2023 work by Sougwen Chung and Leslie Tan, presented at SIFA in 2023.

simple-net-art-diagram-snad.b: Simple Net Art Diagram (SNAD) is a 1997 work by MTAA.

skew-j17.b: Skew J17 is a 1985 plotter drawing in pigmented ink on paper by Mark Wilson.

the-earth-eaters.b: The Earth Eaters is a 2025 software-based animation by Marina Zurkow and James Schmitz, a modern fairy tale about the history of mining with visuals based on woodcut aesthetics.
a: Christiane Paul on Defining AI Art

pxl-duo-pod.b: PXL DUO POD is a series by Kim Asendorf, a special version of which will appear at Art Basel Hong Kong's Zero 10 with Nguyen Wahed in March 2026.
a: Kim Asendorf on Breaking His Own Rules
